تستعرون (form VIII)
# تَسْتَعِرُونَ (tastaʕirūna) /tas.ta.ʕi.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# تُسْتَعَرُونَ (tustaʕarūna) /tus.ta.ʕa.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
